value: RLM (Recursive Language Model) by Alex Zhang, Prime Intellect 2026. Solves context collapse by managing context via Python REPL, delegating to sub-LLMs recursively. No summarization = zero info loss. Agents work on month-long tasks. Sub-agents handle tool-intensive work, main agent stays lean. Proven on DeepDive, Oolong (1.5M char contexts). Training via RL will unlock full potential. https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24601
